method.description: Enumerate every unordered triple and copy its three registered pair relations. The highest-priority pair gate determines screen_class; this is triage, not a satisfiability decision.
method.screen_class_rule: The first present relation in relation_priority supplies one mutually exclusive screen class.

executable_witnesses.claim: One finite bridge carrier jointly realizes RACH causal multiplicity, MRM response equivalence, and CED deterministic target licensing.
One four-world carrier jointly realizes TU-1 reverse-reuse failure, TU-3 loss-response adequacy, and TU-4 strict warning refinement.

claim_ceiling: Complete 220-triple pair-profile coverage and two bounded shared-carrier witnesses only. Pairwise labels remain human judgments, and the screen neither discovers nor excludes emergent three-way inconsistency in unmodelled triples.
